{{PageDisplay}} [[File:Bakery.png|left|200px|Bakery]] {{Infobox |title = [[Production Buildings|Machine]] |level = 4 |price = 20 |time = 10 s |slots = 2 |size = 3×3 }} The '''Bakery''' is a [[Production Buildings|production building]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 4. It is used to make bread, cookies, muffins and pizzas. {{Clr}} ---- ==='''Appearance'''=== The Bakery is a large, ginger oven with few sacks of flour beside it and a small wooden table in front of it. The floor is tiled. It matches the look of the [[Popcorn Pot]], the [[Cake Oven]] and the [[Pie Oven]]. The mastered version gets copper-colored parts and a golden star on the side. ---- === '''Building''' === It costs 20 {{Infoicon|coin}} and takes 10 seconds to build the Bakery. It gives players 3 {{Infoicon|xp}} when completed. ---- === '''[[Products]]''' === {{Building Products |Bread|4|5m|21 |Corn Bread|7|30m|72/8 |Cookie|10|1h|104/13 |Raspberry Muffin|19|45m|140 |Blackberry Muffin|26|45m|226 |Pizza|33|15m|190 |Blueberry Muffin|33|45m|230/28 |Spicy Pizza|37|15m|226 |Potato Bread|39|45m|284 |Frutti di Mare Pizza|45|15m|403 |Gingerbread Cookie|86|30m|273 |Banana Bread|91|30m|424/50 |Macaroon|101|30m|421/50 |Pineapple Coconut Bars|120|40m|284 }} ---- === '''Upgrading''' === {{Main|Production Buildings}} The Bakery originally has two slots available. Unlocking the third slot costs 6 [[diamond]]s. Players can unlock 7 new slots in total, each new one costing 3 more {{Infoicon|dia}} than the previous one. Alternatively, they can spend a total of 105 {{Infoicon|dia}} to completely upgrade their machine. ---- === '''Mastering''' === A total of 735 hours of production is required to [[Masteries|master]] the Bakery: {| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="1" style="text-align: center; margin: 1em 0; border-collapse: collapse;" |- |rowspan="3"|[[File:Bakery Mastered.png|150px|Mastered Bakery]] |style ="border: 1px solid #bbb; background: #ddd;"|'''★
35 hrs''' |style ="border: 1px solid #bbb; background: #ddd;"|'''★★
140 hrs''' |style ="border: 1px solid #bbb; background: #ddd;"|'''★★★
560 hrs''' |- |style ="border: 1px solid #bbb;"|[[File:TruckM10Coins.png|100px]] |style ="border: 1px solid #bbb;"|[[File:TruckM10XP.png|100px]] |style="border: 1px solid #bbb;"|[[File:Bakery Mastery.png|100px]] |- | style="border: 1px solid #bbb; background: #ddd;" |'''+10% {{Infoicon|coin}}''' | style="border: 1px solid #bbb; background: #ddd;" |'''+10% {{Infoicon|xp}}''' | style="border: 1px solid #bbb; background: #ddd;" |'''15% faster''' |} ---- === '''Strategy tips''' === * Many products from the Bakery require [[egg]]s and [[wheat]]. * All products sell well at max. price. * Very large quantities of [[bread]] are requested in [[boat]] orders. * Bread and corn bread are the ingredients of many other products in the game so make sure you always keep a good stock of these. {{Clr}} ---- {{Navigation}} {{Languages |de = Backofen |es = Panadería |fr = Boulangerie |it = Panetteria |nl = Bakkerij |no = Bakerovn |ru = Пекарня |sv = Bageri |vi = Lò bánh mỳ |zh = 面包房 }} [[pt-br:Padaria]] [[Category:Production Buildings]]
